```{sql}
SELECT species, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(CORR(bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm),3) bill_corr, ROUND(AVG(bill_length_mm),1) bill_len, ROUND(AVG(bill_depth_mm),1) bill_depth, ROUND(AVG(flipper_length_mm),1) flipper FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY species;
```

```{r}
d <- subset(penguins, complete.cases(penguins[, c('species','bill_length_mm','bill_depth_mm')]))
fit <- lm(bill_depth_mm ~ bill_length_mm * species, data=d)
summary(fit)$coefficients
anova(lm(bill_depth_mm ~ bill_length_mm + species, data=d), fit)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
x = penguins.dropna(subset=['bill_length_mm','bill_depth_mm','species'])
pooled = x['bill_length_mm'].corr(x['bill_depth_mm'])
within = x.groupby('species').apply(lambda g: g['bill_length_mm'].corr(g['bill_depth_mm']), include_groups=False)
counts = x.groupby('species').size()
pooled, within, counts
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plot_data = penguins.dropna(subset=['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'species']).copy()
colors = {'Adelie': '#3973ac', 'Chinstrap': '#d9822b', 'Gentoo': '#4c9a6a'}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6))

for species, group in plot_data.groupby('species'):
    ax.scatter(group['bill_length_mm'], group['bill_depth_mm'], s=28, alpha=.68,
               color=colors[species], label=f'{species} (r = {group.bill_length_mm.corr(group.bill_depth_mm):+.2f})',
               edgecolor='white', linewidth=.35)
    sns.regplot(data=group, x='bill_length_mm', y='bill_depth_mm', scatter=False,
                color=colors[species], ci=None, line_kws={'linewidth': 2}, ax=ax)

sns.regplot(data=plot_data, x='bill_length_mm', y='bill_depth_mm', scatter=False,
            color='#252525', ci=None, line_kws={'linewidth': 2.5, 'linestyle': '--'}, ax=ax)
ax.plot([], [], color='#252525', linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5,
        label=f'All species (r = {plot_data.bill_length_mm.corr(plot_data.bill_depth_mm):+.2f})')
ax.set(title='Bill length and depth: the pooled trend reverses within species',
       xlabel='Bill length (mm)', ylabel='Bill depth (mm)')
ax.legend(frameon=False, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(alpha=.18)
fig.tight_layout()
fig
```
